title: Finding a record without reading all of them
intro: A literal search across every durable store, in authority order. It exists so that a worker can find what was already decided instead of deciding it again.

scenarios.title: A term that appears in the records
scenarios.explain: Each hit names the kind of record, the file and the line, so the result can be opened rather than merely counted.

scenarios.title: A term that appears nowhere
scenarios.explain: Exit 12 rather than 0, so a script can tell absence from failure without parsing the output.
